plan.title: 为什么清洗后的运动鞋不宜直接贴近暖气烘干？
plan.core_promise: 说明更安全的鞋类干燥判断：避免以局部高温换取表面快速变干。
plan.primary_carrier: a porous outer plane near a dense inner pocket, separated by a widening interval

visual_progression.entry: a quiet porous field at the left edge
visual_progression.development: a denser contained cluster draws closer from the right
visual_progression.resolution: the two remain visibly separated by a protective interval

must_show: a porous outer field and a dense contained inner cluster remain distinct
a clear interval separates the two conditions rather than forcing them together
the composition suggests uneven moisture distribution without a recognizable object
must_not_imply: a recognizable shoe, heater, fan, person, product, or room scene
a precise drying temperature or timing claim

local_colours.target: the sole declared title selection field

scene_integrity.rationale: cover expresses the source promise through abstract moisture distribution and separation only

plan.source_support: 靠近热源时，外侧鞋面会优先升温、优先变干；但鞋头深部、鞋垫下方及内衬与中底之间的区域，仍可能保留较高湿度。表面已经干燥，并不代表整双鞋的含水量已降到适合穿着的水平。
plan.intent: resolve the difference between a dry surface and remaining internal moisture
plan.source_anchor: 干燥的核心，是水分迁移而非表面升温
plan.reader_block: 读者应能判断：外层变干不能证明鞋内已干透。
plan.source_relation: near a heat source, the outer upper dries before the deep toe, beneath the insole, and between lining and midsole
plan.subtitle: 表层先干，深处仍可能潮湿
comparison_basis: the outer upper is visibly dry while deep internal zones retain moisture marks
the dry outer layer and wet inner cavities are separated by the shoe structure
plan.visual_solution: A single lightly-oblique sneaker in shallow flat cutaway: a thin dry outer textile contour stays pale and open, while the toe cavity, under-insole pocket, and lining-to-midsole seam show three compact gray moisture marks. The intact shoe has a slightly open collar and one partial insole lift, with a small irregular cluster of moisture marks tucked inside; one translucent uneven brand-green wax-pencil gesture follows the internal seam only.
must_show: the outer shoe surface is visibly dry and separated from deeper interior zones
the toe cavity, under-insole area, and lining-to-midsole seam retain visible moisture marks
the intact shoe structure makes the dry exterior and wet interior readable as different conditions
must_not_imply: that every shoe will remain wet for a fixed time
that heat is the only cause of interior moisture
a product test, material measurement, or medical claim

local_colours.rationale: local reading emphasis for the hidden interior zone

visible_evidence: a pale unmarked outer textile shell is visibly distinct from three internal moisture-marked pockets
the lifted insole and cutaway seam make the interior locations readable without relying on the title

continuity_rules: the shoe remains one complete connected object
the lifted insole remains visibly attached to the same shoe opening

plan.source_support: 更稳妥的处理顺序是：先取出鞋垫，松开鞋带并拉开鞋舌；用干毛巾轻压鞋内可见积水，避免反复扭拧鞋面或中底；随后将鞋放在阴凉、干燥且空气流动的位置，使空气能够从鞋口进入，并带走蒸发出的水汽。
plan.source_anchor: 先降低自由水，再建立稳定的通风路径
plan.reader_block: 读者应能按顺序先打开结构、再吸除可见水分、最后让空气穿过鞋内。
plan.source_relation: open the shoe structure, absorb visible water, then establish airflow through the shoe opening
plan.subtitle: 先减少自由水，再维持气流
plan.visual_solution: One intact shoe system unfolds across three small ordered states in a calm asymmetric cluster: first, a shoe with loosened laces, lifted tongue, and its insole placed directly beside its opening; second, the same shoe receives one folded dry towel pressing only visible pooled water at the opening; third, the same shoe faces a sparse set of ordinary airflow lines entering through the collar and carrying small vapor marks away. Use shallow flat-cutaway views, a broad slightly tilted silhouette, connected objects only, and one small uneven brand-green wax-pencil fill on the opened tongue edge.
must_show: the insole is removed and the laces and tongue are opened before drying
a dry towel presses visible water without twisting the shoe structure
air enters through the shoe opening and carries vapor away after excess water is absorbed
must_not_imply: high-temperature heating or a fixed drying duration
that the towel is stuffed tightly inside the shoe
a powered drying device or brand-specific product

local_colours.rationale: local reading emphasis for the opened structure

visible_evidence: three visibly ordered shoe states are linked left to right by two restrained directional lines
each state changes the same shoe system in the source-supported sequence: opened, towel-pressed, ventilated

continuity_rules: each state shows one intact connected shoe with no detached or duplicated parts
the insole appears only as the intentionally removed component beside the first opened shoe state
